fusions.name: Clamp and Shake
fusions.desc: Bites down and shakes. It deals 7 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 30% for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Hound of Force
fusions.desc: Sends a war hound into the first enemy it meets, where it deals 28 damage. Your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Stand Guard
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Mastiff at Heel
fusions.desc: A bonded mastiff fights beside you, biting enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds and slowing them by 20% for 2 seconds.
